info.title: Modern Treasury Universal API
info.description: Modern Treasury provides treasury and payment operations APIs for accounts, counterparties, payment orders, ledgers, reconciliations, documents, events, and related financial workflows.

get.description: Retrieves account collection flows from Modern Treasury.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.
